guide.title: Getting started
guide.description: Five steps and your viewers can request songs.
guide.step1Body: In the Basic tab switch Song Request on and save. From then on !sr works in your chat.
guide.step2Body: Create a Browser Source with this URL. It's the overlay that plays audio: without it the queue doesn't move. Use the canvas size shown under the preview.
guide.step3Body: Requested music can get your VODs muted. OBS can play it live without recording it in the VOD:
guide.obs1: On the player source, check “Control audio via OBS”.
guide.obs2: In Audio Mixer → Advanced Audio Properties, put that source on a single track only (for example track 2).
guide.obs3: In Settings → Stream (Twitch), enable “Twitch VOD Track” and pick a different track than the music.
guide.obs4: Your viewers hear the music live and the VOD stays without it.
guide.step4Body: To show the song in another scene or place without duplicating the audio, use this URL. It has its own design.
guide.step5Body: Your viewers see the live queue on this page. !queue shares it in chat.

commandHelp.srremove: Removes the song at that queue position.
commandHelp.srban: Bans the song that's playing, or a user if you mention them.
commandHelp.srvolume: Tells the volume, or changes it from 0 to 100 (!srvolume 40).
